card.name: Boxed warning wording: CDAD and NSAID risk
card.fires_on: Fires on the word or punctuation just before a stock warning phrase. Examples are 'antib' after 'If CDAD is suspected or confirmed,' and the comma or 'and' after 'myocardial infarction'.

modes.label: CDAD warning
modes.description: The start of 'antibacterial' after 'If CDAD is suspected or confirmed,' or the full stop after antibacterial agents.
modes.example: If CDAD is suspected or confirmed,<< antib>>acterial use not directed against C. difficile

modes.label: NSAID cardiovascular warning
modes.description: The comma or 'and' after 'myocardial infarction' in the NSAID boxed warning, just before 'stroke'.
modes.example: including myocardial infarction<< and>> stroke, which can be fatal.

modes.label: Antipsychotic mortality warning
modes.description: The word 'of' in 'incidence of death' in the dementia-related psychosis warning.
modes.example: the incidence<< of>> death in olanzapine-treated patients
